name: Thrissur
scopeLimits: The official Kerala eMaps/BhuNaksha portal is a village-level cadastral map and parcel-sketch system. The ranked WUP point is not a village boundary. No parcel polygon was retained because the official viewer’s certificate failed validation during direct inspection and the specific Thrissur village/extent was not resolved. No account, CAPTCHA or individual land-record lookup was used.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Kerala’s Directorate of Survey and Land Records operates BhuNaksha/eMaps, and its official description says citizens can obtain digital sketches for parcels in mapped villages. The official DSLR directory lists Thrissur district survey and mapping offices. This confirms local survey/cadastral functions, but not point-specific coverage.
technicalBlocker: The Kerala Department’s official e-Maps link points to emaps.kerala.gov.in, but requests timed out and the TLS certificate validation failed. No TLS bypass was used, so viewer JS, service schema, and parcel geometry were not verified.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the official e-Maps service is temporarily unavailable or whether another official endpoint serves the same city-specific cadastral map; parcel coverage at the WUP point remains unknown.
nextStep: Retry the official viewer when its TLS certificate validates, select the correct Thrissur district/taluk/village from public selectors, then make a bounded geometry-only request if supported.
